academyImport.title: Import data
academyImport.desc: Bulk upload to migrate from another platform: your student roster and weekly schedule as CSV.
academyImport.studentsDesc: One row per student: email, name, plan and until when they paid. If they don't have an account we send them an invite by email.
academyImport.studentsCols: Columns: email, name, phone (optional), plan, paid_until (optional, YYYY-MM-DD)
academyImport.scheduleDesc: One row per weekly block. Rows with the same series name group into a single series of the month.
academyImport.scheduleCols: Columns: series, weekday, start_time, end_time + optional: style, level, capacity, instructor_email, month
academyImport.error: Couldn't import the file. Check it's a CSV with the template's columns.
academyImport.forbidden: You don't have access to this academy's import.
